rationale: With only 5 minutes to close, any position opened now would be liquidated at market close, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a stock that has already dropped ~10% today and is trading near its session low with no clear momentum signal. The last five 1-minute candles show tight, directionless consolidation between $13.61-$13.68 with no breakout catalyst, and the risk/reward of a 5-minute trade with forced market-close liquidation does not justify entry in either direction.
